finding: IOS builds the PSU identity from a selected bundled EEPROM template. Arata chooses the 66 W template when two PoE supply status bytes are zero, otherwise a 230 W template. Internal PoE detection uses an additional status byte. This explains a credible route to the incorrect displayed rating; it does not establish why the live flags are absent or prove a repair.
static_trace: libcpa_sb_rp_base_data_arata.so: cpa_sb_rp_base_arata_platform_init sets pd_type0x11ec at virtual0xb90/0xbac (object+0x5c0).

libcpa_core_sb_mirabile_common.so: cpa_sb_get_fru_info_from_hw calls dash_fpga_get_poe_psu_status at0x20f7c, six-byte response at stack+0x10. Dispatch at0x21028 uses halfword table0x4fc7c and base0x21054; pd_type0x11ec resolves to0x2150c.

At0x2150c–0x21518, OR of response bytes0 and1 selects path0x47fb8 (arata_66w_psu_eeprom) if zero, or0x47f4e (wilson_230w_psu_eeprom) otherwise. Selected file becomes a software SPROM symlink at0x215cc. File identities verified as PWR-CC2-66WAC/V02 and PWR-CC1-230WAC respectively. Wilson filename does not establish another chassis or hardware compatibility.
libdash_fpga_api.so: dash_fpga_get_poe_psu_status issues ioctl0x80066651 (six returned bytes).

dash_fpga.ko ioctl dispatch0x15d00–0x15d0c leads to0x15f54. Reads FPGA region+0x32120 and returns register bits0,2,4,6,8,9 as bytes0–5. iocomp variant independently uses same offset and extraction through iocomp_reg_read at0x1c9e4. Neither variant was executed locally.

libcpa_core_sb_mirabile_common.so: cpa_sb_poe_db_status_get reads the same six-byte status. For non-Charon, non0x1187 path, response byte4 must be nonzero and at least one of bytes1/3 nonzero for returned state0; otherwise state2. Thus a profile-name substitution does not satisfy independent controller detection.

The sysfs show_poe_status callback reads the same status register; it provides a possible future read-only observation route. No live sysfs path has been established. Later kernel logs identify the I/O-component driver, but its running binary hash and raw status register remain unverified.
validation: Exact template strings and Arata table target independently checked with Python struct against ELF bytes; objdump symbols/disassembly inspected. No vendor executable loaded/executed, source binary patched, firmware flashed, EEPROM modified, or status flag forced.
